integrity: The concrete all-parameter signed Lefschetz proof is explicit; finite verifier runs are reproducibility checks, not infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Two equal rows, canonical label reversal only. Fixed-set homotopy types and full automorphism representations not determined; unindexed overlapping work remains possible. Previously known nonequivariant sphere classification is not a new contribution.
title: Reflection orientation and quotient homology of two-row \(t\)-Young complexes
